mechanisms.benchmarkSubset: B02 temporary corridor closure and reopening
B04 waiting while owner stays away and an item is present, then release

eventPhase: WorldTick.END after recording the primary actor frame; owner position is applied via native setPos/setPosition at each following WorldTick.START, recording planned/after-call/END physical facts

rawNbtBinding.scope: Compare two complete snapshots of the same actor on the same engine; preserve tag types, list element types/order, exact float bits, arrays and Modified UTF-8 bytes; compound key order alone is unordered. Retain both original SNBT strings. No cross-engine full NBT semantic equivalence.

attributeInputs.comparison: Exact binary64 initial values; any nonzero representation tolerance is reported separately and never makes exact equality true

sourceBasis.original: Fixed EntityMaid.createAttributes, LivingEntity.createLivingAttributes and Attributes; AttributeMap instance/supplier lookup and AttributeInstance modifier/value methods
sourceBasis.port: EntityMaid.applyEntityAttributes, EntityLivingBase.applyEntityAttributes, EntityLiving.applyEntityAttributes and SharedMonsterAttributes; BaseAttributeMap and ModifiableAttributeInstance getters
sourceBasis.modifierOperations: 0 addition; 1 multiply the base after additions; 2 multiply the running total
sourceBasis.bounds: Only the captured initial base/value/modifiers are compared; range/clamp behavior over other values is not claimed equivalent

attributeInputs.unmappedPolicy: Keep complete raw entity/attribute NBT and all actual attribute names; unknown or one-sided mappings remain NOT_PROVEN
attributeInputs.scope: Five source-backed actual initial attribute inputs only; not full NBT, environment, RNG, physics or complete B10 equivalence

scope: Exploratory natural complete O/F/N roots for three related mechanisms only. Collection success is not task success, noninferiority or real logged-in/multi-client owner acceptance. notCapturedMetrics: actual path request count and multiple transient requests within a tick
formal confidence intervals and noninferiority decision
stillRequired: same-contract real logged-in owner and actual multi-client runs
user-approved noninferiority margin if such a margin is adopted
